title: [MAIN]-Bug 648518 Source Currency VAT Amount is zero on G/L Entry when posting sales invoice with Line Discount Deferral Code and Discount Posting is No Discounts
summary: Fixed Source Currency VAT Amount being posted as zero on G/L entries for sales invoices that combine a line discount, a deferral code and Discount Posting set to No Discounts. In that case the amount is now the calculated VAT, and source currency amounts balance across the G/L entries.
key_points: Sales Post Invoice codeunit corrected in the W1 layer and several localized layers
With deferral, line discount and No Discounts combined, Source Currency VAT Amount now equals (Unit Price - Discount) x VAT%
Source Currency amounts balance to zero across the posted G/L entries
Tests added to ERM Source Currency in the W1, CZ, ES, IT and RU layers
quote: Source Currency VAT Amount is not zero when all three conditions are present.
